case.summary: A bank model risk score of 0.61 on the flagged transaction triggered the investigation, supported by the customer having 4 closed cases on file. It was assumed the customer made the transaction because no graph evidence beyond the alert pointed to fraud and similar profiles were cleared upon confirmation. The decisive evidence was that the customer confirmed they made the transaction, and the amount $77.07 and product W sit within their normal range of $26-$382. Following Fraud Policy R3, because the customer confirmed the transaction, the verdict is legitimate and the case is closed with the confirmation noted in the file.
